extracted.name: Dr Pepper brownies
extracted.description: Two recipes on this one. Homemade brownies mix or if you if have a box brownie mix. Fun recipe. Didn’t have chocolate chips, have to make this again with some.
ingredient_lines: Mix all the ingredients in a medium bowl. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 40 minutes
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease 9×9 baking pan. Mix together all of the dry ingredients except chocolate chips. Stir in Dr Pepper until blended. Now stir in chocolate chips. Pour the mixture into prepared baking pan and bake for 30-40 minutes. Serve and Enjoy!
